# Credit Loan Risk Assessment Strategy 2026

This document details the critical monitoring and optimization tasks for the 2026 strategy within the Credit & Loans department.

## Key Objectives:

*   Monitor borrower credit scores for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize interest rates on a quarterly basis.
*   Monitor default risk quarterly.
*   Investigate updates to default risk standards.
*   Update default risk assessments quarterly.
